title: Invoice with tax
prompt:
Read an invoice from standard input. Each line is either an item `DESCRIPTION;QTY;PRICE` or the tax line `tax=RATE` (at most one, anywhere; the last one wins if there are more). DESCRIPTION is any non-empty text without `;`. QTY is a whole number from 1 to 9999 written with digits only. PRICE is an amount of money written with digits and optionally a `.` followed by one or two digits (`12`, `3.5`, `0.99`). RATE is a percentage written the same way, at most two digits after the point (`8`, `8.25`). Blank lines are skipped, and any other line prints `line N: invalid` (N counts from 1) and is ignored.

Work in cents with whole numbers, never with floating point. For each valid item print `DESCRIPTION: QTY x PRICE = TOTAL` where PRICE and TOTAL are written with exactly two digits after the point and TOTAL is QTY times PRICE. After the last line print `subtotal=S`, `tax=T` and `total=G`, in the same two-digit form, where S is the sum of the item totals, T is S times RATE percent rounded to the nearest cent with halves rounded up (T is 0.00 when there is no tax line), and G is S plus T.

cases.name: example
cases.stdin:
Widget;3;4.50
Gadget;1;19.99
tax=8.25
Broken line
Cable;12;0.35
Free sample;2;0

tax=3.11
